```{r oackages used}
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggthemes)
```


```{r import the data and clean}
homicides <- read.csv("../data/homicide-data.csv")

baltimore <- homicides |> 
  filter(city == "Baltimore")
```

Homework Choice: Choice 2 

```{r making graph data set}
baltimore_graph <- baltimore |> 
  mutate(reported_date = ymd(reported_date)) |> 
  separate(col = reported_date,
           into = c("year", "month", "day"),
           sep = "-") |> 
  mutate(month = month(as.numeric(month), 
                       label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE)) |> 
  select(year, month, victim_last, victim_first)

monthly_homicides <- baltimore_graph |> 
  group_by(year, month) |>  
  summarise(monthly_homicides = n(),
            .groups = "drop_last") |> 
  mutate(season = case_when(
    month %in% c("November", "December", "January",
                 "February", "March", "April") ~ "Winter",
    month %in% c("May", "June", "July", "August", "September",
                 "October") ~ "Summer"))
```

```{r graph, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 3}
monthly_homicides |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = monthly_homicides, fill = season, 
             group = month)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  labs(x = "Date", y = "Monthly homicides")+
  ggtitle("Homicides in Baltimore, MD")+
  theme_dark()

```
